# Python tools the CI installs (see the "Install bashate" step of
# .github/workflows/bash-ci.yml): `pip install --require-hashes -r` refuses
# anything that is not listed here with a matching hash.
#
# bashate needs pbr, and pbr needs setuptools; all three are pinned. Each hash
# is a sha256 from PyPI's JSON API (digests.sha256) for the wheel and the sdist
# of that release. Dependabot (pip, /.github/ci) proposes updates, hashes
# included.

    --hash=sha256:3104d565a7a0f7ee2cf4028cc584c723a202f52a8ddffe4a39b8cbb0ac5d3e94 \
    --hash=sha256:4bab6e977f8305a720535f8f93f1fb42c521fcbc4a6c2b3d3d7671f42f221f4c
pbr==7.1.3 \
    --hash=sha256:6583e878a1d97cb135fdc509811f31b9235905cde8d4dacd3dbadf9efc45d745 \
    --hash=sha256:9a4a85b84e906337708009af0b5f5cdabeeb72d4dc213c9e97974da54fd9acc5
setuptools==84.2.1 \
